name: K.S. Terminals Inc.
summary: K.S. Terminals Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electrical terminals, automotive connectors, battery modular connectors, and EV charging connectors in Taiwan, the rest of Asia, America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through K.S. Terminals in Taiwan and Chien Ho Hsing (Suzhou) segments. The company offers AC, DC fast, and E-scooter charging connectors; electrical terminal products, including non-insulated terminals and lugs, insulated copper terminals, insulated quick disconnectors, cord end terminals, butt splice and other connectors, DIN terminals, waterproof heat shrinkable terminals, reel mounted terminals, and crimping tools and machines; automotive…
